§3§lPurpose and mechanism§r
Foundation work proceeds through §6pouring, steam heating, then static curing§r. Each chunk contains 16 cells covering 4×4 blocks each. New cells take 2 seconds at base speed and support lossless overclocking. Each consumes 50,000 L of concrete plus the NEI item bill; progress is recorded per completed cell.

§3§lPreparation and operation§r
Steam heating requires 1,800 accumulated seconds at 1,000,000 L/s of superheated steam, followed by 24 hours of static curing. Voltage does not overclock these two stages. During static curing, optional critical singularities in the loom input bus are consumed every 20 seconds: n items reduce the remaining time by n/[5×(16+n)] per interval. Curing also completes without them. Thick map borders mark chunks; small cells mark pours; gold marks the active cell.
